1 · Return and conversion

A commercial goal:
more traffic, more sales.

Increase Elite Fit’s visibility and the traffic to its website, then optimise for conversion.

  1. Visibility and traffic

    Be found far more often, and bring more people to the website.

  2. Conversion

  3. Business strategy

Digital Movement · Elite Fit BaliThe goal

The project has a commercial goal: more visibility and traffic first, then conversion, meaning more day passes and more memberships sold, among other things. Business strategy is part of the project.

07 / 24

1 · Return and conversion

We create traffic by being found:
on Google and in AI search.

We find the most important searches people use for these services, and build a page for each top search. Anyone interested finds Elite Fit, on Google and in AI search such as ChatGPT.

Searches like these

  • “sauna bali”720 a month
  • “best gym bali”
  • “calisthenics bali”
  • “best coaches bali”
  • “day pass gym bali”

More pages for top searches → More traffic → More buyers

It’s a numbers game.

Searches a month: Semrush, Indonesia, Oct 2026, shown where the exact search is in our 50-search study.

Digital Movement · Elite Fit BaliHow we create traffic

"sauna bali" has 720 searches a month (Semrush, Indonesia database, October 2026). The other four examples are not in the 50-search study word for word, so no figure is shown for them.

08 / 24

1 · Return and conversion

Three pillars
carry the project.

  1. Google and AI search visibility

    A page for every top search, so people looking for what Elite Fit sells find it.

  2. A premium website built to convert

    Best practice that makes buying and checkout as easy as possible: a sticky booking button, a contact form at the top.

  3. Technical integration

    One platform that connects all the tools and platforms Elite Fit uses.

Digital Movement · Elite Fit BaliThree pillars

Pillar 1 brings the traffic, pillar 2 turns visits into bookings and purchases, pillar 3 connects booking, membership and payment so a purchase is recorded and confirmed.
